_comment: Known glossary-injector damage that could not be recovered from git history. See tools/validate-vocab-attributes.mjs. These ceilings may only go DOWN.

malformedSpans.why: All 50 were recovered from pre-damage revisions in git history. Zero tolerance from here.

bareTermAttributes.why: A JS/URL attribute whose entire value is a glossary term (style="width", onclick="factor"). 93 of 114 were recovered from git history; the remaining 14 sit in files whose attribute counts have drifted since the damage, so positional recovery is unproven. They need a per-case look, not a guess.
